title: era.box 1.1
description: content::EraBox: an entry in the Grand Prix and Time Trial era picker that opens a package.

title.description: absent or empty: the package's title

time_trial.description: absent: Time Trial uses the package's entrant list

entrant_list.description: the entrant list the box selects on the Time Trial picker, in swofty_f1's entrant lists like the package's; empty: the package's

extends.description: Data files only: this record is a variant of that record, and its value is a merge patch on the base.
